name: Listening for the Lie
description_short: The teacher tells a short true-sounding story containing one planted factual inconsistency - students have to catch it and explain what's wrong.
teacher_note: No audio file, no external listening resource - you are the listening material. Comes with a fast contradiction-generator method plus five ready-made stories, so there's no real prep even the first time.
creator: Free Range Tutors
